# Code of Conduct

swissarmy-usb is a small project, and we want it to be a friendly place to
ask questions, report problems and send changes, whatever your experience.

## Our standards

- Be respectful and patient, especially with people who are new to Linux,
  Bash or open source.
- Give and take feedback on the work, not the person.
- Assume good intent, and ask before assuming.
- No harassment, insults, discrimination, sexual content, or personal
  attacks, in any form.
- Don't publish other people's private information.

## Scope

This applies everywhere the project is discussed: issues, pull requests,
discussions, and any other place where you represent the project.

## Reporting

If someone's behaviour bothers you, contact the maintainer,
[@migueltc13](https://github.com/migueltc13), privately (the email on their
GitHub profile), or use GitHub's **Report content** option on the comment.
Reports are kept confidential.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, close issues and pull requests,
or block people who don't follow this code. Usually a friendly reminder comes
first; serious or repeated cases may lead straight to a ban.

This code is inspired by the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
